jdbcService.sql: with last_runs as ( select ts.id as task_schedule_id, ts.task, ts.schedule, tq.name as queue_name, tq.id as task_queue_id, t.scheduled as last_scheduled, row_number() over ( partition by ts.id, tq.id order by t.scheduled desc nulls last, t.started desc nulls last, t.created desc nulls last ) as row_number, t.started as last_started, t.stopped as last_stopped, t.state as last_state, case when t.state = 'SUCCEEDED' then true when t.state in ('ERROR', 'FAILED') then false else null end as succeeded from ~task_schedules ts join ~task_queue_schedules tqs on tqs.task_schedule_id = ts.id join ~task_queues tq on tq.id = tqs.task_queue_id left join ~tasks t on t.task_schedule_id = ts.id and t.task_queue_id = tq.id and (t.started is not null or t.stopped is not null) where ts.enabled = true and ts.manual = false ), next_runs as ( select lr.task_schedule_id, lr.task_queue_id, min(t.scheduled) as next_run from last_runs lr join ~tasks t on t.task_schedule_id = lr.task_schedule_id and t.task_queue_id = lr.task_queue_id where lr.row_number = 1 and lr.last_scheduled is not null and t.scheduled > lr.last_scheduled group by lr.task_schedule_id, lr.task_queue_id ) select lr.task_schedule_id, lr.task, lr.schedule, lr.queue_name, lr.last_started, lr.last_stopped, lr.last_state, lr.succeeded, nr.next_run from last_runs lr left join next_runs nr on nr.task_schedule_id = lr.task_schedule_id and nr.task_queue_id = lr.task_queue_id where lr.row_number = 1 order by lr.task, lr.queue_name
